requiredBeforeFiling.text: Check your answer to "Which convictions are you trying to clear — for each, the county, the approximate date, the charge and the case number if you have it?" against Records of the convictions you want cleared, and correct the packet if they disagree.
Payment of the $40 certification fee — Enclosed with the mailed request.
Mailing the request — Envelope addressed to the AOC Records Unit.
The participant signs the request. No wet-signature rule beyond the AOC's own form applies.
AOC-RU-009 refers on its face to an exemption of fees if applicable. The criteria are not published and are recorded as an open question.

selfHelpStops.text: The certification comes back saying the participant is not eligible and the participant wants to file anyway. The clerk must still accept the petition, but whether to file against an adverse certification is a decision that needs a lawyer.
The certification lists convictions the participant says are not theirs or are wrong.
The 30-day filing window has run before the participant could file.

processingHandoff.text: Processing takes roughly four to five months. The packet waits on the certification; the participant is told to expect that and is reminded when the 30-day filing window opens.

repairedFindings.whatWasWrong: Zero of the manifest's eight requiredBeforeFiling entries appeared verbatim; the "Required before sending" section listed two widget-level items (SSN, DLN).
The record's destination.detail names the portal as kcoj.kycourts.net/RecordRequest and both guidance files said only "the official AOC record-request portal".

repairedFindings.verification: The URL was NOT typed from the dispatch brief. It is a build-time constant asserted against the committed record -- `assert.ok(track.destination.detail.includes(PORTAL_URL))` -- so the build fails rather than publishing a portal address the record does not contain.
